styles.name: 八方旅人方向 · 立体像素
styles.description: Octopath Traveler inspired HD-2D sprite craftsmanship, original character identity. Sculpt head, torso, sleeves and boots with deliberate 3-5 tone material clusters: clear light plane, midtone, cool shadow plane and restrained contact occlusion. Readable face, hair clumps, overlapping garment masses, grounded feet. Preserve identical palette ramps and volume landmarks across poses. Crisp native pixel stair-steps, selective dark outline; no vector-flat fills, smooth gradients, plastic rendering, blur, bloom or baked background shadows.

styles.name: 玖镇 · 清晰国风
styles.description: Chinese HD-2D RPG pixel character, readable face and clothing, restrained colors, coherent pixel clusters, dark single-pixel outline, low relaxed walking steps. Preserve Chinese costume construction and accessory laterality.

styles.name: 冒险 · 硬边像素
styles.description: Crisp adventure RPG pixel character, readable silhouette, compact deliberate clusters, restrained 3-tone material shading and dark single-pixel outlines. No blur, no subpixel antialiasing.

styles.name: 田园 · 柔和像素
styles.description: Gentle pastoral pixel character, warm muted material palette, clean silhouette, economical pixel clusters, subtle dark outline. No painterly texture, no antialiasing.

idle.name: 待机
idle.rule: Feet and head remain fixed. Only chest, hands and connected sleeves breathe slightly. Belt ornaments remain fixed to torso.

walk.name: 行走
phases: far foot passes low by supporting ankle
near foot passes low by supporting ankle
walk.rule: Alternate support feet with opposite arm swing. Relaxed low passing foot, no high knees, no whole-body translation pretending to walk.

battle_idle.name: 战斗待机
battle_idle.rule: Stable grounded combat stance; preserve weapon hand and weapon shape.

attack.name: 普通攻击
attack.rule: Readable weight transfer, consistent weapon, grounded support foot; no missing hands.

cast.name: 施法
cast.rule: Readable hand gesture, no baked VFX obscuring character; preserve accessories.

hit.name: 受击
hit.rule: Clear recoil then recover, no morphing or dismemberment.

death.name: 倒地
death.rule: One-way collapse, not a loop; final frame remains on ground.

movement.name: 移动包 · 四向待机与行走
